acceptanceCriteria: A cmd/corvint test asserts that every code name listed in testsHelp is a code the test-validity reader can emit (and the reverse for non-internal codes), failing on drift.
body: Found closing PR #1166 (V1-1866/1867): the lane edited testsHelp (cmd/corvint/help.go:223) to add RB-* codes, and no cmd/corvint test renders or asserts it; grep for testsHelp/RB-CHANGE-ON-IDENTITY in cmd/corvint/*_test.go matches nothing. A stale or wrong code list in help would ship unnoticed except by use-case-receipts-check.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1398); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). Owner 2026-10-21: CI-checked work needs no local full-gate. Evidence file sha256 5f9795ccde57d75fd0af9380173cee15c33fe1242af366667025a5304b4ac081.

title: cmd/corvint: no test pins the `corvint tests` help text (testsHelp); only use-case-receipts-check covers it
